title: Reports site ownership
responsibility: Binds a reports server to its application checkout and delegates repository-identity ownership checks.

inputs.name: ownedBySite.project
inputs.description: Checkout path to check for ownership by this report site. The implementation compares it with the cached site root using repository identity, so a worktree or fresh clone of the same application can match while a same-named directory from another repository does not.

outputs.name: reportSite
outputs.description: Module-cached description of the application site, computed on its first call from the resolved, trimmed HARNESS_SITE_ROOT or the current working directory. It uses the Git top-level when available and otherwise the requested directory; the name is the primary checkout basename when available and otherwise the root basename, and the repository identity is null outside a Git repository.

outputs.name: ownedBySite
outputs.description: Whether the project path belongs to the repository identified by the cached site root. A worktree or fresh clone of the same application can match; matching directory names alone do not establish ownership.
